# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Compared the three pending amendments against current HEAD and found they are already implemented in the repository: the overview and chemistry screens now share the same NH3-N unit wording (`mg NH3-N/L`), `tank_core::TankSnapshot` deserialization now absorbs legacy chemistry aliases with canonical-field precedence so enriched/legacy snapshot payloads deserialize directly, and the public water/state/snapshot TDS-conductivity path now goes through the shared fresh-carbonate projection helpers in `WaterState` instead of diverging from the snapshot path. No net code changes were required in this round because the worktree already matched the needed implementation; I validated the behavior with targeted tests and clippy.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Compared the pending amendment list against the current `tank_core` and `tank_tui` sources to determine whether any runtime gaps still remained.
1. [Completed] Confirmed that `TankSnapshot` now normalizes legacy chemistry aliases during deserialization with canonical precedence, and that API/TUI enriched snapshot payloads no longer require a client-local alias shim to deserialize.
2. [Completed] Confirmed that `WaterState`/`TankState` TDS and conductivity accessors now share the same fresh-carbonate projection used by `TankSnapshot`, and that the overview/chemistry screens use the same NH3-N unit wording.
3. [Skipped] Skipped additional code edits because current HEAD already satisfied all three pending amendments.
4. [Completed] Ran targeted validation across the touched core, API, and TUI paths to verify the already-landed implementation.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo test -p tank_core --lib` passed (49 tests), including `types::snapshot::tests::snapshot_deserializes_legacy_chemistry_aliases`, `types::snapshot::tests::snapshot_deserializes_enriched_api_payload_with_canonical_precedence`, and `types::snapshot::tests::snapshot_tds_and_conductivity_use_fresh_carbonate_projection`.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test concentration_helpers` passed (11 tests), including `tds_helpers_ignore_stale_bicarbonate_cache`.
- `cargo test -p tank_tui --lib` passed (10 tests), including `api_client::tests::parses_enriched_api_snapshot_response`, `api_client::tests::parses_load_response_with_legacy_snapshot_chemistry_field_names`, and `screens::overview::tests::overview_uses_shared_nh3_n_unit_label`.
- `cargo test -p tank_api` passed (3 tests), covering legacy chemistry aliases and estimate-scope metadata on snapshot responses.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_core -p tank_api -p tank_tui -- -D warnings` completed successfully with no warnings.

## Outstanding Risks

- The pending-amendment list was stale relative to current HEAD, so this round was verification-only rather than a new patch set.
- The repository still has unrelated untracked workspace artifacts in `.ralph-burning/`; they were left untouched.
- I did not run the full workspace test matrix beyond the targeted `tank_core`, `tank_api`, and `tank_tui` coverage plus clippy for those crates.
